verdict.rationale: Several hands-on users independently say kitty supports programming-font ligatures well, for example with FiraCode, and the docs include a 'Changing kitty fonts' page. However, the pack has no content showing fallback-font configuration or fine-grained font tuning, and one user notes bitmap fonts are unsupported. Missing for 10: documented fallback/symbol font mapping, documented fine-grained tuning options (e.g. size, spacing, feature settings), and first-party ligature configuration details.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use programming fonts with ligatures, fallback fonts, and fine-grained font tuning

citations.quote: has the best support for ligatures I've seen in a terminal. With FiraCode, it makes code beautiful in the terminal
I liked Alacritty well enough, but it doesn't support ligatures. Kitty does, so that's what I use.
